exodus.30.p1.b1.text: “You are also to make an altar of acacia wood for the burning of incense. It is to be square, a cubit long, a cubit wide, and two cubits high. …

exodus.30.p1.b2.text: Place the altar in front of the veil that is before the ark of the Testimony —before the mercy seat that is over the Testimony—where I will meet with you.

exodus.30.p1.b3.text: And Aaron is to burn fragrant incense on it every morning when he tends the lamps.

exodus.30.p1.b4.text: When Aaron sets up the lamps at twilight, he must burn the incense perpetually before the LORD for the generations to come.

exodus.30.p2.b5.text: “When you take a census of the Israelites to number them, each man must pay the LORD a ransom for his life when he is counted. Then no plague will come upon them when they are numbered.

exodus.30.p2.b6.text: … must pay a half shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel …

exodus.30.p2.b7.text: … the rich shall not give more than a half shekel, nor shall the poor give less.

exodus.30.p2.b8.text: Take the atonement money from the Israelites and use it for the service of the Tent of Meeting. It will serve as a memorial for the Israelites before the LORD to make atonement for your lives.”

exodus.30.p3.b9.text: “You are to make a bronze basin with a bronze stand for washing. Set it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water in it,

exodus.30.p3.b10.text: with which Aaron and his sons are to wash their hands and feet.

exodus.30.p3.b11.text: Whenever they enter the Tent of Meeting or approach the altar to minister by presenting an offering made by fire to the LORD, they must wash with water so that they will not die.

exodus.30.p4.b12.text: “Take the finest spices: 500 shekels of liquid myrrh, half that amount (250 shekels) of fragrant cinnamon, 250 shekels of fragrant cane,

exodus.30.p4.b13.text: You are to consecrate them so that they will be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.

exodus.30.p4.b14.text: Grind some of it into fine powder and place it in front of the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be most holy to you.
